_about: Who holds today's five Hello New Home areas, mirrored from hq/content/areas-seed.json in the Hello New Home
workspace on 20 October 2026. scripts/load_territory_model.py applies this to a district only while the district
is still open with no partner, so a holding changed on the Territories screen is never overwritten by a load.
A bare postcode area (E, TA) means every district of that area in the ONS Postcode Directory extract.
partner_id is the Hello New Home partner id (people.hnh_partner_id). The ids 3 and 4 are placeholders until the
London and Somerset partner records exist in Hello New Home; edit them here or on the district screen.
state is one of open, reserved, core, hq. reserved_until is a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null.

territories.name: Swansea (head office)
territories.note: The operating model keeps SA1 to SA7 permanently and serves SA8 to SA18 from head office until they are released to a Welsh partner [CONFIRM]. Both load as hq; release the second group on the district screen when the founder decides.

territories.name: Durham
territories.note: A launch territory with no partner yet ([Partner name] in areas-seed.json): earmarked, not offered. The operating model's proposal is core DH1, DH2, DH3, DH7 and reserved for the rest once a partner signs [CONFIRM].

territories.name: Andover
territories.note: A launch territory with no partner yet. The operating model's proposal is core SP10, SP11 and reserved SP9, RG28, SO20 once a partner signs [CONFIRM].

territories.name: London
